name: Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R
engine: 998 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's liter superbike. Several recalls across the years. Check for track and crash wear.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Recalls include the regulator/rectifier on 2008-2011 bikes (12V064), transmission gears on 2016-2018 bikes, and an ECU backfire fix on 2019-2020 bikes (20V307).
A-002.reason: These can strand you, lock the gearbox or cause a fire. Repairs are free.

E: Check the frame spars, subframe and fairing mounts for scrapes and cracks.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier may not charge the battery properly.
ECU programming can cause backfires that damage the air suction valves.
recalls.fix: Dealer reprograms the ECU and replaces damaged parts free.

known.title: Transmission gears
known.what: Kawasaki recalled 2016-2018 ZX-10Rs because hard shifting could break gears.
